channel.title: Quiz Couple · Blog
channel.description: Quiz Couple articles on relationships, psychology and love stories.

item.title: Toxic man in love: the 6 profiles that damage (and how to recognise them)
item.description: Not every toxic man is a narcissistic abuser. The 6 profiles of the toxic man in love, what they put you through, and which ones can change.

item.title: Juliette Drouet wrote 22,000 love letters to Victor Hugo: their story
item.description: For fifty years, Juliette Drouet wrote to Victor Hugo almost every day. She lived almost shut away for him, then followed him into exile after saving his life. Here is their story.

item.title: After Pierre died, Marie Curie kept writing to him: the Curies' love story
item.description: A meeting in 1894, a wedding with no white dress, two bicycles for a honeymoon, radium, then the accident of 1906. The love story of Pierre and Marie Curie.

item.title: Marie Antoinette and Fersen: what X-rays found under the scribbled-out lines of their letters
item.description: Parts of the letters between Marie Antoinette and Axel von Fersen were blacked out with ink. Researchers read them with X-rays: here is what they said, and who hid them.

item.title: 60 perfect questions to ask early in a relationship
item.description: In the first weeks you don't dare ask anything for fear of breaking it all. Wrong: here are the 60 early-relationship questions, paced so no stage gets skipped.

item.title: Breaking up with a narcissist: how to go about it
item.description: Leaving a narcissist is like no other break-up. What to prepare beforehand, what he'll do afterwards, and how to hold the no contact.

item.title: Emotional dependency in men: the love-sickness nobody sees
item.description: Jealousy, anger, need for control, back-to-back relationships... Male emotional dependency doesn't look like the cliché, and that's why we miss it.

item.title: 60 questions to get to know each other better, even if you think you know everything
item.description: After years together, you think you've covered it all. Wrong! 60 questions to ask each other to check... and rediscover yourselves along the way.

item.title: Do I love him, or am I afraid of losing him?

item.title: Toxic relationship: what it is and how to recognise the signs

item.title: 75 questions to ask your girlfriend, to (re)discover her
item.description: Think you know her by heart? Bet: out of these 75 questions to ask your girlfriend, there are at least ten whose answer you don't know.

item.title: The narcissistic woman: 10 signs men don't dare name
item.description: Adorable in public, demolishing in private. The 10 signs of the narcissistic woman, her masks, and why the men who endure her never talk about it.

item.title: How to overcome emotional dependency: 12 concrete exercises
item.description: A 3-phase plan with 12 concrete exercises to overcome emotional dependency, week after week, with the traps to know along the way.

item.title: 65 intimate questions to ask your partner, from the gentlest to the boldest
item.description: Intimacy isn't only under the covers: it's also in the questions you dare to ask. 65 intimate questions, graded from tender to scorching.

item.title: The narcissistic manipulator: how to spot him easily
item.description: His techniques in the order he uses them, his real weak points, the effect of silence on him and his reactions when unmasked. The complete manual.

item.title: Symptoms of emotional dependency: examples and outcomes
item.description: The phone checked 40 times, the fear of silence, the relationship taking up all the space... The 16 symptoms of emotional dependency, area by area.

item.title: The 90 best questions to ask a girl to get to know her

item.title: The 35 favourite phrases of manipulators

item.title: 100 questions to ask your crush
item.description: Tired of conversations that fizzle out? 100 questions to ask your crush, sorted by situation: by message, to make them laugh, to flirt, to see if it fits.

item.title: Narcissistic man: 12 signs, from public charm to private control
item.description: Flawless in public, crushing in private. The 12 behaviours of a narcissistic man, in the order they appear, and what to do next.

item.title: He cancelled last minute: what it means and what to reply
item.description: He has just called off your date an hour before. What that means most of the time, the one signal worth watching, and the messages to send him.

item.title: The signs that show a man is nervous around a woman

item.title: How does a man feel when you ignore him?

item.title: 100 questions to ask your boyfriend, from light to the big conversations

item.title: Narcissist in love: recognising coercive control while you're still inside it

item.title: One couple in three argues on the drive to their holiday, and it started before they left

item.title: The stages a man goes through when he falls in love

item.title: The signs that tell you whether to end a relationship or keep going

item.title: Love bombing: how to tell real love from manipulation
